#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 2 review helper: revert only F1 (-B) and F3 (the quoted array) in apply.sh and hash each candidate.
If a candidate hashes to round 1's e52f548e979a..., nothing else in apply.sh changed.
    python3 -I r1rebuild.py <apply.sh> <out path for the matching (or first) candidate>
"""
import hashlib
import itertools
import sys

R1 = "e52f548e979ae0c0b9831f72b0ec9d2792e4a1cfa53c4aed6ba682d90792db03"
src, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(src, encoding="utf-8").read()

NEW47 = ("SETS_GLOBS=('fixtures/evaluation/*/hidden/**' 'fixtures/evaluation/*/XCHECK-r*.md' "
         "'runs/*/miss-classes.json' 'runs/*/misses.jsonl')")
GLOBS = "fixtures/evaluation/*/hidden/** fixtures/evaluation/*/XCHECK-r*.md runs/*/miss-classes.json runs/*/misses.jsonl"
OLD47 = [f'SETS_GLOBS="{GLOBS}"', f"SETS_GLOBS='{GLOBS}'", f"SETS_GLOBS={GLOBS!r}"]
NEW65 = '  python3 -I -B - "$ROOT/$MAP" "${SETS_GLOBS[@]}" <<\'EOF\''
OLD65 = ['  python3 -I - "$ROOT/$MAP" $SETS_GLOBS <<\'EOF\'', '  python3 -I -B - "$ROOT/$MAP" $SETS_GLOBS <<\'EOF\'',
         '  python3 - "$ROOT/$MAP" $SETS_GLOBS <<\'EOF\'']
NEW97 = '  python3 -I -B - "$ROOT/$SCRIPT" "$LIST" "$ROOT" <<\'EOF\''
OLD97 = ['  python3 -I - "$ROOT/$SCRIPT" "$LIST" "$ROOT" <<\'EOF\'']

for needle in (NEW47, NEW65, NEW97):
    print(f"present once: {text.count(needle) == 1}  {needle[:60]}")

first = None
match = None
for a, b, c in itertools.product(OLD47, OLD65, OLD97):
    cand = text.replace(NEW47, a, 1).replace(NEW65, b, 1).replace(NEW97, c, 1)
    h = hashlib.sha256(cand.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    first = first or cand
    hit = h == R1
    print(f"{h[:12]} {'MATCHES round 1' if hit else '-'}  47={a[:24]}... 65={b.strip()[:22]}...")
    if hit:
        match = cand
open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(match or first)
print("round 1's bytes rebuilt exactly" if match else "no candidate rebuilt round 1's bytes; wrote the first candidate")

mkdir -m 0700 "$PR/indep-walls"

[ $rc = 0 ] && grep -q '^state applied' "$T/a1.txt" && ok "apply: state applied" || bad "apply: exit $rc"
grep -q '6 template lines, 7 brief lines .*template mismatches 0; brief mismatches 0' "$T/a1.txt" && ok "the launch script's parser reads the list (6, 7, 0, 0)" || bad "the parse line"
AP check > "$T/c2.txt" 2>&1; rc=$?; hide < "$T/c2.txt"
[ $rc = 0 ] && grep -q '^check: already applied' "$T/c2.txt" && ok "check in the applied state: already applied (parse_check ran)" || bad "check applied: exit $rc"
snap "$R" > "$T/tree-after.txt"; snap "$PH" > "$T/home-after.txt"; gsnap > "$T/git-after.txt"
